ops.text: cc-sudo CI: swift test hung once (run 37453204518, head 4a4d480, Oct 6 2026). It stalled for 17 minutes with 144 tests started, 54 passed, and none of the serialized SynckitClientTests begun. A rerun of the same head passed in about 2 minutes. This looks like cooperative-pool starvation from tests that block threads (Process.waitUntilExit), not the synckit fixture. The job has no timeout-minutes, so a hang burns the 6h default.
